description: This source file defines an internal interface 'IInternalGrainFactory' within the Orleans distributed application framework. The interface extends 'IGrainFactory' and provides methods for creating object references, retrieving system targets, and casting grain references, all typical for internal factory functionalities related to grains and system targets.

classes.name: IInternalGrainFactory
classes.description: An internal interface extending IGrainFactory, providing methods for creating references and casting grains within Orleans.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a reference to a provided object implementing IAddressable.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget (by GrainType and SiloAddress)
methods.description: Retrieves a system target reference for a given grain type on a specified silo.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget (by GrainId)
methods.description: Retrieves a system target reference for a given grain ID.

methods.name: Cast (by grain)
methods.description: Casts a grain to the specified interface type TGrainInterface.

methods.name: Cast (by grain and interface type)
methods.description: Casts a grain to a specified interface type, given the interface Type object.
